source.guideQuestion: Do you think it's important to have a good memory?
source.exactGuideSentence: A strong memory is a real advantage at work.
source.guideMeaning: A meaningful practical benefit; a reusable evaluation phrase.
source.sourceFidelity: The proposal retains the exact guide example as guide_original_example and labels its practice scenes as new situations; no source-question answer is asserted from the guide example.

sevenStepEditorialReview.reason: A uniquely explains the repair-desk benefit; distractors overstate what memory guarantees or contradict the queue.
All four options constructively explain why Arin can guide drivers; only C contains a real advantage.
B denies the sign-language communication benefit and C absurdly says visitors understand only without signing; both directly conflict with the scene, making A trivial.
C’s decorative badge confers no task benefit; A/B show practical benefit.
B claims evacuation can never be dangerous and C says exits help only in an empty building; the latter is unrelated and implausible. A is too obvious.
Exact target span and task-specific road-blocked sense are correct.
Debate preparation and evidence retrieval transfer the practical-benefit sense away from repair work and route guidance; two complete answers and five source-answer glossary rows fit.

traditionalChinese: All question prompts, options, model sentences, writing answers and takeaways have intelligible Traditional Chinese with no decisive key or polarity mismatch. Any revised content needs a fresh bilingual check; rendered line wrapping has not been assessed.
requiredFixes: Replace scene alternatives with plausible but narrower benefits or incomplete explanations of the sign-language skill, preserving one best answer.
Replace dialogue alternatives with credible overbroad or partial claims about emergency-exit knowledge, not impossibilities or irrelevant assertions.
verdict: REVISE — source-faithful lesson and writing pass, but scene/dialogue distractor quality fails the SOP.
limits: This is an editorial/source review of the exact local proposal. No audio clips were generated or heard; no browser, physical-device, backend, publication or rights-clearance gate was run.
